To answer seriously: I can't directly terminate employees through the AI assistant. Employee terminations require proper HR processes, documentation, and often legal considerations.

What I *can* help with:
• Start the offboarding process for an employee
• Update employment status to 'inactive'
• Set a last working date
• Create offboarding tasks and checklists
• Schedule exit interviews

nah all good just wondering what the limits are

Totally understandable! Here are my safety limits:

**What I CAN do:**
✅ Update employee data (with audit trails)
✅ Book leave and manage schedules
✅ Upload documents
✅ Query/analyze data
✅ Create workflows and automations
✅ Bulk salary updates (with confirmation)
✅ Start offboarding processes

**What I WON'T do:**
❌ Delete employee records permanently
❌ Bypass audit requirements
❌ Make changes without confirmation
❌ Share sensitive data across companies
❌ Execute irreversible actions without approval

Everything I do:
• Requires confirmation for sensitive changes
• Gets logged in audit trails
• Can be undone within 48 hours
• Follows your company's permission rules

Feel free to ask if you're ever unsure about what I can help with!
